post.description: Login with email and password. Data is protected by HTTPS/TLS encryption in transit.

Register a new user account. If company data is provided, a new company will be created and the user will be assigned as Admin. If no company data is provided, the user will be created without a company and must be invited to join a company.

company.description: Optional: jika ada, akan create company baru dan user jadi Admin

code.description: Optional, but if provided must be unique

vehicle_id.description: Optional vehicle UUID (FK to vehicles table)

total_in_qty.description: Sum of quantities for IN + ADJUST_IN

total_out_qty.description: Sum of quantities for OUT + ADJUST_OUT

owner_email.description: Optional: email of user to assign as Admin
